audit.why: 52.05% over 5322 games, Ahri on all seven rows in both layers and in packet.levelChart — consistent with 4/10 difficulty. TF never wins a straight duel; his threat is map-wide.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] names a nonexistent item, 'Firstblast/Lich Bane', and no cooldown numbers appear (Pick a Card 6s flat, Wild Cards 6 -> 5s, Destiny 170/140/110).
audit.why: Destiny at 170s is why your early roams are unanswerable, and the full layer already builds Malignance.
audit.corrected: Item corrected to Malignance; cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, ahead and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors. (a) whys[0] and spikes[0] call Wild Cards 'short-range poke' — its range is effectively lane-length in the kit data, far past your 970. (b) early says 'Wild Cards has a long cooldown early' — it is 6s at rank 1. (c) spikes[0] refers to 'level 6 stealth' — Twisted Fate has no stealth; Destiny reveals enemies and enables Gate. The real interaction, Pick a Card being an autoattack reset at 200 range, was absent.
audit.why: Riot text: Q 'throws three cards' at 10000 range, 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5s; W 'uses that for his next attack' at 200 range with an autoReset flag; R 'revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate'.
audit.corrected: Range and cooldown claims corrected, stealth claim removed, autoattack-reset tell added.

audit.whatIsWrong: The burst tell was never named: his kill combo opens with an autoattack reset, so the wind-up is the cue, not the card lock.

edits.before: You out-trade his short-range poke with charm+combo before he has any way to punish the engage.
edits.after: Wild Cards crosses the lane, but the gold card needs 200 range — charm punishes every walk-up he makes.

edits.before: Once you have Q-W-E online you can bully TF's short-range Wild Cards pokes by charming through minions and following with orb/fox-fire; he has no way to punish your engage before level 6 stealth.
edits.after: Once Q-W-E is online you punish the Pick a Card wind-up: the gold stun needs an autoattack at 200 range, so charm him as he steps up and follow with orb and fox-fires before he can lock a card.

edits.before: You outrange and outburst him in lane from level 1 — Wild Cards has a long cooldown early and if he throws it at minions to farm, you can walk up and charm him before he resets. Keep your own wave pushed so he can't safely stack cards for the gold-card stun combo. Once you hit level 3 with all three basic abilities you can force trades he simply cannot answer without a landed stun first.
edits.after: You outburst him in lane from level 1 — Wild Cards is only 6s, but it is mana-hungry at 60 up front, and every card he throws at the wave is one he isn't holding for you. Keep your wave pushed so he can't safely cycle Pick a Card for the gold stun. Once you hit level 3 with all three basic abilities you can force trades he cannot answer without landing that stun first.

edits.before: Firstblast/Lich Bane spike lets you one-rotation him from further away than his blue/red cards threaten, and his squishiness makes every trade lethal for you.
edits.after: Your Malignance spike lets you one-rotation him from 970 while every card he owns needs a 200-range autoattack, and his frame makes each trade lethal.

edits.before: Bait blue/red card cooldowns before committing to trades
edits.after: Watch the card he locks — only gold stuns, blue refunds mana

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. It governs your forward steps. - R Spirit Rush (last dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is 6s flat and only 200 range — the gold stun is an autoattack reset, so the wind-up animation is your cue to step back, not the card lock. - Wild Cards is 5-6s but costs up to 100 mana. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1 and reveals you, so it is a gank timer, not a duel button.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry through picks — charm him at 970 and he dies before the card he locked ever reaches your health bar.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt the map: shove with Q, dash-flank every river, and charm-pick Twisted Fate's teammates until the lane lead is a game lead.
edits.after: Ahead, shove with Q and roam first — Destiny is 170s at rank 1, so until it is up he cannot answer a single one of your rotations.

edits.before: That is Twisted Fate’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: His gold card turns an even trade into a stun — never start level.

edits.before: If Twisted Fate opens the score, reset expectations and respect Pick a Card (Gold) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q clears and stay relevant through charm picks.
edits.after: If Twisted Fate opens the score he roams on it — Destiny plus a lead is two lanes lost, so ping and follow. After a second, Q-clear, hold charm for the gold card, and pick elsewhere.

notes: Three factual errors fixed: Wild Cards called 'short-range' (it is the longest-range ability in the lane), called 'long cooldown early' (6s at rank 1), and a reference to 'level 6 stealth' that Twisted Fate does not have. spikes[2] also named a nonexistent item, 'Firstblast/Lich Bane' — replaced with Malignance to match the full layer's build. Level chart already agreed across both layers, no chart edits needed. Did not assert whether charm interrupts the Gate channel or whether the gold-card stun is shortened by tenacity — not in the kit text.
